data.long_meaning: The name Diann has Greek origins and is derived from the Greek word 'dios' meaning 'god' and 'anemo' meaning 'wind'. Diann was an ancient Greek goddess of the moon, nature, and fertility. In Christianity, the name Diann can be seen as a reminder of God's graciousness and divine protection. The name Diann carries the meaning “Gracious Goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Diann usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
